name: twins
description: Tells you when two copies of something drift apart, and never edits anything itself. List pairs of folders in twins.json; when a session edits one side, a band says the other copy is behind. /twins shows the changed files and a line count; only /twins sync <name> asks Claude to port the change, and /twins done or ignore clears it.

twinsFile.title: Project twins file
twinsFile.description: Path, inside the project, of the file that lists twin pairs. ~/.claude/twins.json is always read too.
